# Interactions (generated by `./build/dump_content --interactions` from the game's tables)


## Element combos (a skill of another element flying through a zone)

- Water + Earth → Mud: a mud field, slows 50 %
- Water + Fire → Steam: a steam cloud (blocks vision)
- Water + Air → Ice shards: freezes, slows 40 %
- Earth + Fire → Lava: a lava pool that burns
- Earth + Air → Sandstorm: blinds
- Fire + Air → Firestorm: the fire skill +50 % size and damage
- Group bending: every ally of the same element feeding a zone: +25 % size, +20 % damage, +1 s (max 4 feeds)

## Walls (the standard)

- Skill walls: segments 100 units long, 33 / 66 / 99 thick, 1 or 2 levels high; HP per segment 300 (ice 100, metal 600); a segment falls as a whole
- A unit whose whole body fits on a rising segment is lifted on top: level 1 = it can walk off, level 2 = trapped without mobility
- Metal walls: one thin segment by default; lightning within 192 units bends towards them and hits everything within 33 units of the struck piece
- Single cells (map rocks, lava rocks, thrown rocks): ice 90 / stone 140 / metal 300 HP; map rocks × 200 % and grow back after 180 s
- Lava on the ground melts walls next to it every 250 ms: stone 4, ice 20, metal 3 HP; touching ice halves the lava's rest time once; 12 % of lava cells cool into a rock
- Thrown earth / lava bolts leave a small rock where they land; earth bolts / waves can lift a chosen rock first (click the rock, then the target): +25 % range, +20 % damage
- Lifted stones (boulders) block walking like walls; Stone Push throws anyone's lifted stone
- Some autoattacks hit walls (right click on a wall) — per champion

## Water

- Wet lasts 5 s (1 s for waterbenders); a wet unit cannot catch fire; the first fire hit on a wet unit −25 % and dries it
- Water on lava cools it into stone and makes steam (3 s); Heat Draw turns steam into puddles (8 s) and gives 20 fuel
- Ice through steam condenses it into a puddle (or an ice patch); ice patches slow
- Water skills from a source (river, sea, glacier, puddle, ice patch, ice wall) cost no carried water; chosen source: +25 % range, +15 % damage
- Ice walls cost more water than a bender carries → need a source; an ice wall used as a source loses 30 HP; the Avatar carries 150 water (60 per skill)
- Moving water (Draw Stream…): the water is taken from the source (a river dries for a while, a puddle moves) and lies at the target as a new source
- Swimming: no spells (only water mobility); freezing / slowing CC on a swimmer lasts 50 % longer; ice on a swimmer = an icing stun

## Lightning

- Lightning chains through connected shallow water; a redirect window sends incoming lightning to the cursor — also lightning thrown by an ALLY
- Metal walls attract lightning (see Walls)

## Sky (day, moon, comet, eclipse, alignment)

- Moon phase   0 %: water power +0.0 %
- Moon phase  50 %: water power +25.0 %
- Moon phase 100 %: water power +50.0 %
- Full moon: water ranges / sizes +25 % (water autoattacks too), cooldowns × 0.90
- Comet = 2 × full moon for fire: power +100 %, sizes +50 %, cooldowns × 0.80, unlimited fuel
- Solar eclipse: fire loses power towards the middle and is muted in the middle; planetary alignment: every bender's magic +25 % power / size / duration
- Day: fire +5 % power, fuel regenerates faster towards noon; night: shorter sight (by the moon's light)

## Crowd control and fights

- Displacement (knock) = CC: the unit is held for distance / 1200 units per s
- Everybody collides with everybody (allies, minions, monsters); spirits, ghost items and mist form pass through
- Champion kill: bounty 300 gold (+100 per kill in a row, max 1000; −50 per death in a row, min 100); assisters share 50 %; XP 140 + 30 × level, shared nearby
- A champion who hit the victim in the last 10 s gets the kill even when a turret / minion / monster lands the last hit

## Travel companions (recall)

- The chosen animal runs from the base at 1000 units/s, carries the champion home at the same speed; it cannot be stopped or cancelled; the rider can be hit
